screening.reason: Inclusion 2-3: a voxel-wise group-difference analysis of inter- and intra-hemispheric resting-state functional connectivity density between ASD and TDC using ABIDE I data.

evidence_spans.text:
We used resting state fMRI data of 458 subjects with ASD and
517 TDCs (see Table 1 for additional demographic information)
among 1112 datasets from the ABIDE datasets
evidence_spans.claim: 458 ASD and 517 TDC subjects were selected from 1112 ABIDE datasets.

evidence_spans.text:
We excluded
datasets from the social brain Lab BCN NIC UMC Groningen
and Netherlands Institute for Neurosciences due to the missing
information of a full-scale intelligence quotient (IQ) for many
subjects. After preprocessing, we found that a large part of the
cerebellum was missing in the imaging dataset of Carnegie
Mellon University, and all datasets from Carnegie Mellon
University were excluded. To control for potential confounding
eﬀects of IQ in our analysis, we decided to exclude ﬁve datasets
that included some subjects with IQ lower than 70. Finally, we
performed voxel-wise group comparisons with 975 imaging
datasets.
evidence_spans.claim: Sites/datasets were excluded for missing FIQ (Groningen), incomplete cerebellar coverage (Carnegie Mellon), or low IQ (<70, five further datasets), leaving 975 datasets for voxel-wise comparison.

evidence_spans.text:
Datasets were preprocessed with SPM8 (http://www.ﬁl.ion.ucl.
ac.uk/spm/software/spm8/). The ﬁrst step was realignment for
head motion correction. Images were realigned to the ﬁrst
image and a mean echo planar image (EPI) was created during
this step. Subsequently, structural T1 images were coregistered
to their mean EPI data. Registered EPI data of each subject
were normalized to Montreal Neurological Institute (MNI)
template and spatially smoothed with 8 mm of full-width at half-
maximum. Then, in the temporal domain, the linearly increasing
trend due to heat absorption was removed at each voxel, and
the eﬀects of the head motion, white matter, cerebrospinal ﬂuid,
and global signal were regressed out. Lastly, temporal band-pass
ﬁltering was applied (0.01–0.08 Hz).
evidence_spans.claim: Data were preprocessed with SPM8: realignment, coregistration, MNI normalization, 8mm smoothing, detrending, nuisance regression (motion, WM, CSF, global signal), band-pass filtering.

evidence_spans.text:
2-tailed t-test design with two covariates of age
and sex was used to compute the statistical signiﬁcance of the
FCD diﬀerences between the two groups. Statistical signiﬁcance
was based on the false discovery rate corrected P < 0.05 together
with requiring 20 voxels for the minimum continuous voxel
size within a cluster (corrected P < 0.05).
evidence_spans.claim: Group differences were tested with a 2-tailed t-test (age and sex covariates), FDR-corrected P<0.05 with a minimum cluster size of 20 voxels.
Both inter- and intra-hemispheric FCD were significantly decreased in ASD vs TDC in the posterior cingulate cortex, lingual/parahippocampal gyrus, and postcentral gyrus.
ADOS-RRB scores showed significant negative correlations with inter-hemispheric and contralateral FCD in the lingual/parahippocampal gyrus cluster.

evidence_spans.text:
In several sites, the datasets contained clinical information
such
as
the
Autism
Diagnostic
Interview-Revised
(ADI-
R), the restricted and repetitive behavior subscore of the
Autism
Diagnostic
Observation
Schedule
(ADOS-RRB),
and communication subscore of the ADOS (ADOS-COM).
evidence_spans.claim: Clinical diagnosis-related measures used included ADI-R, ADOS-RRB, and ADOS-COM subscores from the ABIDE phenotypic data.

assessments.support: Explicit site/IQ/coverage-based exclusion rules and resulting N (975 of 1112) are reported.
458 ASD and 517 TDC from a defined subset of ABIDE sites, with demographics in Table 1.
SPM8 preprocessing pipeline with standard nuisance regression and band-pass filtering is explicitly described.
ADI-R and ADOS (RRB, COM) clinical measures from the ABIDE phenotypic data are used and correlated with connectivity.

Age and sex are modeled as covariates; head motion is regressed as a nuisance signal, but no explicit motion-based subject-exclusion threshold (e.g. FD cutoff) is reported; site is not included as a covariate despite pooling 15 sites.
Age/sex covariates and motion nuisance regression are used, but no site covariate or harmonisation is applied despite acknowledged multi-site heterogeneity.
Voxel-wise global/inter-/intra-hemispheric functional connectivity density (FCD) is a clearly defined, previously validated data-driven metric.
FDR correction (P<0.05) with a minimum cluster size of 20 voxels, and Benjamini-Hochberg correction for correlation analyses.

risk_of_bias.summary: Cohort definition, preprocessing and multiple-comparisons correction are transparently reported, but no motion-based subject-exclusion threshold or site covariate/harmonisation is described despite pooling 15 ABIDE sites, leaving residual site-confound risk in the Analysis/Confounders domains.

charting.title: Abnormalities of Inter- and Intra-Hemispheric Functional Connectivity in Autism Spectrum Disorders: A Study Using the Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange Database
charting.primary_goal: Examine whether ASD functional under-connectivity originates from ipsilateral or contralateral (inter-hemispheric) brain regions using whole-brain voxel-wise FCD mapping
charting.country_region: Multi-site (subset of ABIDE I sites contributing both ASD and TDC)
charting.diagnosis_assessment: ADI-R, ADOS-RRB and ADOS-COM subscores (ABIDE phenotypic data)
charting.dataset_openly_available: ABIDE data publicly available; no separate analysis code repository mentioned
charting.specific_features: Global, contralateral (inter-hemispheric), and ipsilateral (intra-hemispheric) functional connectivity density maps; no ROI atlas (whole-brain voxel-wise)
charting.feature_change_direction: Hypoconnectivity: decreased inter- and intra-hemispheric FCD in ASD vs TDC in posterior cingulate cortex, lingual/parahippocampal gyrus, and postcentral gyrus
charting.validation_methodology: Voxel-wise 2-tailed t-test (age, sex covariates), FDR-corrected P<0.05, minimum cluster size 20 voxels; Benjamini-Hochberg correction for clinical-correlation analyses
charting.summary_key_findings: ASD showed significantly decreased inter- and intra-hemispheric functional connectivity density relative to TDC in the posterior cingulate cortex, lingual/parahippocampal gyrus, and postcentral gyrus; ADOS-RRB (restricted/repetitive behavior) scores correlated negatively with FCD in these regions, including the default mode network.
charting.features_associated_disorder: Posterior cingulate cortex, lingual/parahippocampal gyrus, postcentral gyrus (decreased inter- and intra-hemispheric FCD in ASD)
charting.reviewer_notes: No motion-based subject exclusion threshold or site covariate/harmonisation reported, despite pooling 15 ABIDE sites; age and sex only used as covariates.

narrative_row.study_design_sample_dataset: Group-difference (associational) voxel-wise analysis; ABIDE I, N=975 (458 ASD, 517 TDC) after site/IQ/coverage-based exclusions from 1112 raw datasets.
narrative_row.methods: SPM8-preprocessed rs-fMRI; whole-brain voxel-wise functional connectivity density (global, inter-hemispheric/contralateral, intra-hemispheric/ipsilateral) with a 2-tailed t-test (age, sex covariates), FDR-corrected P<0.05, 20-voxel minimum cluster size.
narrative_row.outcomes: Decreased inter- and intra-hemispheric FCD in ASD vs TDC in posterior cingulate cortex, lingual/parahippocampal gyrus, and postcentral gyrus; ADOS-RRB negatively correlated with FCD in these and default-mode-network regions.
narrative_row.key_limitations: No motion-based subject-exclusion threshold reported; no site covariate or harmonisation despite pooling multiple sites; no atlas-based parcellation.
narrative_row.relevance_notes: A voxel-wise (non-atlas) associational use of ABIDE I illustrating a common gap in this corpus: multi-site pooling without explicit site-effect statistical handling.
